title: A Mean Field Games Perspective on Evolutionary Clustering
summary: We propose a control-theoretic framework for evolutionary clustering based on quasi-stationary Mean Field Games. Each cluster is represented by a probability density whose evolution is governed by a Fokker--Planck equation, while the associated velocity field is determined through a stationary Hamilton--Jacobi equation. The general formulation does not prescribe a finite-dimensional statistical shape for the component densities, although the number of components is fixed.
